name: Luric Road: Lamares to Nemetra
terrain: Pasture and farmland, then hazel groves. Orc country to the north. 18 miles, one day.
frequency: Roll once in the morning and once in the afternoon.
description: Roll d12 for the kind of encounter, then roll on that table.

table.encounter: Locals
Sent by someone
Common travellers
Factions
From Velgroth-Lucernia
From Imazuran
Hostile
The road itself
**Heskan Tul** driving **2d10 cattle** east to market. Orcs took two head last month; he pays outriders 5sp a day.
**Chadem** walking east to a ruin with a satchel of paper. Asks whether Medach in Nemetra has found anything. Hopes not.
**Taziri n'Khaleb**'s caravan, 5 wagons eastbound. She looks the party over and counts their weapons.
**Dreban** the mask-carver, turning off the road into the woods with a new mask. Trades a fey story for help carrying it.
**Halbet**'s jar cart westbound to Lamares, the carter walking beside it to save the mule.
**Elder Corveth** limping west to witness an oath at the Lamares fortress. Glad of company.
**1d4 Lamares militia** on Seretta's orders, checking the road for orc sign. They ask what the party has seen.
**Sirnav**'s cart going east for casks of Nemetra's herbed ale and a side of pork.
A militiaman with a letter from **Seretta** to **Captain Durvin**: the orc patrols are too organized. Durvin will laugh at it.
A runner from **Lugo Varden** with an order for 40 spearheads from **Torvek**. Torvek has no iron.
A herb-wife sent west by **Mother Yaleth** for a plant that grows only under the Lamares fortress walls.
**Sirnav** asks travellers to carry a recipe to **Varnis** at the Royal Welcome, and bring hers back.
**Heskan Tul**'s son, offering 5sp a day to anyone who will ride with the herd to Nemetra.
**Chadem** pays 2sp for every inscription copied off a milestone or waystone on the way.
To be built: an orc patrol from the north.
To be built: bandits.
To be built: wolves after the cattle.
To be built.
The road churned to mud by drovers. Cattle dung everywhere.
Hazel groves. Nut-gatherers in the branches call down the price of a sack.
An Isarna crescent freshly scratched on a milestone.
Orc tracks cross the road north to south and back again, three days old.
A dead cow by the road, hamstrung, not eaten. An orc patrol's work: **1d4 orcs** watch from the trees to see who comes.
Kiln smoke on the horizon. Nemetra is close.
Rain. The road knee-deep in places; 1 hour lost.
Nothing. Cattle lowing far off.
